svg.title: An instruction is just wires
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “An instruction is just wires” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch of a sixteen-bit Hack C-instruction drawn as sixteen labelled bit boxes with brackets peeling off each field to what it drives - the opcode, the a bit, the six ALU control pins, the three destination bits and the three jump bits - beside the fetch, decode, execute and write-back loop drawn around a central program counter, a hand-ruled trace table of a six-instruction program showing A, D, M and the PC after each step, a staircase pipeline diagram with one mispredicted branch crossed out in red, and a four-lane SIMD panel annotated with a measured 4.79 times speedup.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
